acme-support: Hey team — our erasure API keeps failing for tenant acme-42. Calls to /v1/erase return a 502 with error `kms_handshake_failed`. Customer is asking for deletion proof; this is urgent.

maria-support: Ack. Can you share the request IDs and a curl repro? Also which deployment (hosted/dedicated/private)?

acme-support: Dedicated. Repro curl below and raw response:

```
curl -v -X POST https://dedicated.redwood.example/v1/erase \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme-42","user_id":"u-9876"}'
```

Response body:

```
{"error":"kms_handshake_failed","code":502,"detail":"signature verification failed"}
```

Server log snippet:

```
[2026-03-10T15:23:11Z] erase id=er-12345 tenant=acme-42 kms_error=handshake_failed hsm_code=0x12f
[2026-03-10T15:24:01Z] erase id=er-12346 tenant=acme-42 kms_error=handshake_failed hsm_code=0x12f
```

oliver-sre: tagging @anna-privacy and @james-sre. Looks like HSM/KMS handshake failures for that tenant CMK. Any recent CMK rotation or cert changes?

acme-support: Customer rotated their CMK and updated client certs last night via the console. Failures started immediately after.

maria-support: I'm opening an infra ticket. Need the exact erase request IDs (you posted two) and last known successful erase timestamp.

acme-support: erase ids: er-12345, er-12346. Last successful erase for that tenant was 2026-03-09T22:40:00Z.

james-sre: I'm looking at the proxy logs — seeing TLS handshake alerts (certificate_unknown / handshake_failure) around both request times. Could be mutual TLS client cert not trusted by HSM proxy after rotation. Can you reproduce with `curl -v` and include the TLS trace?

acme-support: Pasted -v output — shows `SSL alert number 40` / `handshake failure` and `verify return:1` then `certificate unknown`. Their client cert was replaced.

anna-privacy: From a GDPR/DPA perspective: we need to treat these erasure attempts as attempted processing. If physical deletion didn't happen, we must document attempts and inform the data controller (customer) with timeline and evidence. Please preserve all logs and KMS traces. Also we may need to propose fallback (platform CMK) if customer consents so we can complete deletion.

maria-support: Internal tickets created: INFRA-REDW-7892 (KMS handshake failures) and PRIV-332 (erasure evidence & customer notification). Linking request ids and logs.

kms-bot: KMS proxy report for cmk `acme-42-cmk`: last_rotate=2026-03-09T21:58:00Z status=degraded handshake_failures=7 recent_errors=[2026-03-10T15:23:11,2026-03-10T15:24:01]

oliver-sre: Proposed remediation steps:
1) Ask customer to re-upload client cert / confirm CA chain and retry.
2) If customer approves, run a one-off erase using a platform-managed CMK (requires explicit consent and will be logged).
3) Collect full audit bundle (request bodies, HSM traces, proxy logs) and produce a DPA-compliant evidence package.

oliver-sre: Assigning INFRA-REDW-7892 to eng-infra oncall. @maria-support please confirm customer consent for fallback.

acme-support: Customer verbally ok with fallback for this specific erase, wants confirmation in writing. Asking for ETA.

maria-support: ETA for initial triage/update: 2 hours. If fallback approved, we can attempt erase in the next 4-8 hours depending on oncall availability. Will update both tickets and send formal consent request template to the customer.

james-sre: For repro instructions (infra):
```
1) Reproduce with curl -v to capture TLS handshake: `curl -v --key client.key --cert client.crt ...`
2) Grab proxy logs: /var/log/redwood/kms-proxy.log and filter by tenant and request id.
3) Pull HSM audit: hsm-audit-tool --since 2026-03-09T20:00Z --tenant acme-42 > acme-hsm-trace.log
```

maria-support: Noted. Keeping thread open; will post ticket links and consent form once finalized. :thumbsup:
